description: The Norwegian Offshore Directorate FactMaps service is a web feature service (WFS, ED50 UTM32 variant) that exposes the directorate's fact map data, described on the Norwegian data catalogue data.norge.no as information on exploration and production wells, surveys, discoveries and fields, and production licences on the Norwegian continental shelf. The catalogue entry gives the GetCapabilities endpoint, a link to the Geonorge metadata record, the publisher and a contact point at the directorate's customer centre, and states the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. The entry was published on 5 February 2026 and last updated on 20 March 2026; version, availability and fees are shown as not provided. Coverage is offshore Norway. Access: public WFS endpoint, free, with no registration mentioned. Caveats: the catalogue page describes the service, and layer names and attributes were not listed in the text read. It suits offshore oil and gas infrastructure mapping and planning, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
